```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, raster)

source('helpers/palettes.R')
source('helpers/phenotype_map.R')
```

```{r}
# annotations
celltype_annots <- read_csv('annotations.csv')
nbhd_annots <- read_csv('annotations.csv')

# segmentation masks
seg_paths <- list.files('segmentation_0.78mpp_0.075maxima_0.05interior', pattern = 'MESMER_mask.tiff', full.names = T, recursive = T)

seg_list <- list()
fov_names <- list()

for (i in unique(as.integer(celltype_annots$PointNum))) {
  fov_names[[i]] <- str_split(seg_paths[[i]], '/', simplify = T)[,3]
  seg_list[[i]] <- as.matrix(raster(seg_paths[[i]]))
}

names(seg_list) <- fov_names
```

```{r}
celltype_palette_df <- data.frame(annot_palette) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = 'celltype') %>%
  dplyr::rename(colors = annot_palette)

for (i in unique(as.integer(celltype_annots$PointNum))) {
  celltype_plot(point_num = i,
                fov_name = unique(celltype_annots$path[celltype_annots$PointNum == i]),
                seg_list = seg_list,
                annotation = celltype_annots$cellType[celltype_annots$PointNum == i],
                cell_label = celltype_annots$cellLabel[celltype_annots$PointNum == i],
                mypalette = celltype_palette_df,
                verbose = T,
                out = T,
                format = 'pdf',
                out_path = '../pmaps_final/celltype/')
}
```

```{r}
nbhd_palette_df <- data.frame(nbhd_palette) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = 'celltype') %>%
  dplyr::rename(colors = nbhd_palette)

for (i in unique(as.integer(nbhd_annots$PointNum))) {
  celltype_plot(point_num = i,
                fov_name = unique(nbhd_annots$path[nbhd_annots$PointNum == i]),
                seg_list = seg_list,
                annotation = nbhd_annots$CN[nbhd_annots$PointNum == i],
                cell_label = nbhd_annots$cellLabel[nbhd_annots$PointNum == i],
                mypalette = nbhd_palette_df,
                verbose = T,
                out = T,
                format = 'pdf',
                out_path = '../pmaps_final/nbhd/')
}
```
